bias_convention: PyTorch keeps b_ih and b_hh separate; both exported per LSTM layer.
init_state_convention: Each lstm layer carries init_hidden/init_cell (length hidden); reset() loads them instead of zeros.
lstm_equations: i=sig(Wii x+bii+Whi h+bhi); f=sig(Wif x+bif+Whf h+bhf); g=tanh(Wig x+big+Whg h+bhg); o=sig(Wio x+bio+Who h+bho); c'=f*c+i*g; h'=o*tanh(c')
